annotations.title: Check the fit for a company

description:
Fit check for one company. Inputs, all optional: company size, mail provider, up to 20 needs.
        Returns the plan for the size (Enterprise on quote above the largest plan), the mail prerequisites for
        the provider, and a status per need: covered, not_covered (SMS, phone/vishing, attachment and
        ransomware-encryption simulations, with the related training), see_facts, or unknown (no public fact;
        contact address given); plus the known gaps and the trial link.

needs.description: Up to 20 needs, as keys (sms_phishing_simulation, phone_vishing_simulation, attachment_simulation, ransomware_simulation, public_api, qr_code_phishing_simulation, data_protection, hosting_in_france, reports_and_exports, report_button_with_ai_verdict, risk_scoring, practice_exercise, debrief_after_click, fraud_scenarios, french_language, english_language, security_awareness_training, email_phishing_simulation) or short free text, e.g. 'SMS phishing', 'CEO fraud', 'GDPR'.
